text: This report recommends that City Council approve proceeding with Phase Two of the Provincial Affordable Housing Lands Program (PAHLP), which will provide up to 160 new affordable rental and up to 80 affordable ownership homes on the Thistletown site to be delivered by non-profit organizations. The Ontario Government, as part of its Fair Housing Plan, has established a program to leverage provincial land assets to develop a mix of market housing and new, permanent, sustainable and affordable housing across the province. City Council on October 4, 2017 pre-approved Open Door incentives for affordable rental homes in the first phase of the Provincial Affordable Housing Lands Program in the West Don Lands and 27 Grosvenor/26 Grenville Streets.
